accounts_post_kind_length_range.name: accounts_post_kind_length_range
accounts_post_kind_length_range.value: "threads"."accounts"."short_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "threads"."accounts"."post_length_target" AND "threads"."accounts"."medium_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "threads"."accounts"."post_length_target" AND "threads"."accounts"."long_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "threads"."accounts"."post_length_target"

accounts_post_kind_ratio_range.name: accounts_post_kind_ratio_range
accounts_post_kind_ratio_range.value: "threads"."accounts"."short_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "threads"."accounts"."medium_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "threads"."accounts"."long_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "threads"."accounts"."short_ratio" + "threads"."accounts"."medium_ratio" + "threads"."accounts"."long_ratio" = 100

accounts_connection_consistency.name: accounts_connection_consistency
accounts_connection_consistency.value:
("threads"."accounts"."connection_status"::text = 'not_connected' AND "threads"."accounts"."threads_user_id" IS NULL AND "threads"."accounts"."username" IS NULL AND "threads"."accounts"."connection_method" IS NULL)
      OR ("threads"."accounts"."connection_status"::text <> 'not_connected' AND "threads"."accounts"."threads_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."accounts"."username" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."accounts"."connection_method" IS NOT NULL)

post_drafts_reject_reasons_valid.name: post_drafts_reject_reasons_valid
post_drafts_reject_reasons_valid.value:
"threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL OR (cardinality("threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons") >= 1
        AND array_position("threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons", NULL) IS NULL
        AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons" <@ ARRAY['similar', 'tone', 'thin', 'inaccurate', 'too_promotional', 'policy']::text[])

post_drafts_review_state.name: post_drafts_review_state
post_drafts_review_state.value:
("threads"."post_drafts"."status"::text = 'needs_review' AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads"."post_drafts"."status"::text IN ('approved', 'publishing') AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads"."post_drafts"."status"::text = 'rejected' AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND (coalesce(cardinality("threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons"), 0) >= 1 OR coalesce(btrim("threads"."post_drafts"."reject_note"), '') <> '')
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads"."post_drafts"."status"::text = 'published' AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads"."post_drafts"."status"::text = 'publish_failed' AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "threads"."post_drafts"."published_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."publish_error" IS NOT NULL)

post_drafts_blocked_state.name: post_drafts_blocked_state
post_drafts_blocked_state.value:
("threads"."post_drafts"."blocked_at" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."blocked_reason" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."blocked_words" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads"."post_drafts"."status"::text = 'needs_review' AND "threads"."post_drafts"."blocked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."blocked_reason" IS NOT NULL)

post_drafts_threads_media_state.name: post_drafts_threads_media_state
post_drafts_threads_media_state.value: ("threads"."post_drafts"."threads_media_id" IS NULL AND "threads"."post_drafts"."threads_permalink" IS NULL) OR "threads"."post_drafts"."status"::text = 'published'

post_mentions_when.name: post_mentions_when
post_mentions_when.value: "threads"."post_mentions"."delay_minutes" IS NOT NULL OR "threads"."post_mentions"."send_after" IS NOT NULL

post_metrics_judgment.name: post_metrics_judgment
post_metrics_judgment.value: "threads"."post_metrics"."judgment" IS NULL OR ("threads"."post_metrics"."state"::text IN ('confirmed', 'late_confirmed') AND "threads"."post_metrics"."judgment_ratio" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."post_metrics"."judgment_baseline" > 0)

publish_attempts_skip_state.name: publish_attempts_skip_state
publish_attempts_skip_state.value:
("threads"."publish_attempts"."state" = 'skipped' AND "threads"."publish_attempts"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."publish_attempts"."draft_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads"."publish_attempts"."state" <> 'skipped' AND "threads"."publish_attempts"."skip_reason" IS NULL)

publish_attempts_pending_has_draft.name: publish_attempts_pending_has_draft
publish_attempts_pending_has_draft.value: "threads"."publish_attempts"."state" NOT IN ('in_progress', 'retry_wait') OR "threads"."publish_attempts"."draft_id" IS NOT NULL

people_outreaches_target.name: people_outreaches_target
people_outreaches_target.value:
("people"."outreaches"."purpose" = 'invite' AND "people"."outreaches"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "people"."outreaches"."target_name" IS NULL AND "people"."outreaches"."target_key" IS NULL)
        OR ("people"."outreaches"."purpose" = 'work' AND "people"."outreaches"."event_id" IS NULL AND "people"."outreaches"."target_name" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("people"."outreaches"."target_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "people"."outreaches"."target_key" IS NOT NULL)

people_persons_has_name.name: people_persons_has_name
people_persons_has_name.value: "people"."persons"."real_name" IS NOT NULL OR "people"."persons"."line_name" IS NOT NULL
